scope: Local durable Mailbox CPU/file/SQLite performance and exact communication budget accounting; no LLM quality, token, network or fleet completion claims
invariants: exact UTF-8 byte accounting including ACKed deliveries
legacy append writers maintained by triggers
implementation: One-time transactional backfill and per-run usage ledger with INSERT triggers, immutable event/delivery fields under supported Mailbox API. No change to PRAGMA durability. No update/delete/replace external SQL support; preserve legacy Mailbox INSERT and receipt UPDATE behavior.
timing: Full publish API including unchanged validation, DB connection, transaction and commit. Full usage API. Per-case copies of identical populated legacy DBs; seed SQL excluded from steady-state timing and explicitly synthetic. Record initial open/migration separately and reopen. Randomized interleaved arm order; retain every sample; no durability downgrade.

acceptance.primary: backlog=10000,fanout=8,byte_budget=true: baseline/candidate median publish >=1.25 and indexed_scan/candidate >=1.25
acceptance.correctness: all independent SQL reconstructions equal counters; all targeted semantic regressions pass
acceptance.small_cases: report all regressions explicitly, do not claim universal speedup
acceptance.noise: report median/p95 plus all samples; independent representative rerun must reproduce direction

budget: One bounded implementation candidate, at most one correction cycle after review; CPU only, no model/provider spend or GPU. Preserve failed evidence; if primary fails, keep baseline and continue research in a later bounded wake.
supervision: Existing hourly communication automation observed enabled. This is direct host-orchestrated work; tmux is unavailable, no new managed server supervisor or runtime review adapter is claimed. Independent review uses actual collaboration context.

prior_results.decision: reuse as context only; payload/token measurements are not publish accounting latency
reuse as limitation: old short model traces were not CPU-bound; this optimization targets accumulated history, not those model timings

knowledge.decision: reject direct latency theorem transfer: fanout, retries and independent consumers violate single FIFO no-drop assumptions. Use exact additive byte conservation and transaction invariants instead.
